entities.name: Teysa Karlov
entities.description: A 112-year-old Orzhov Grand Envoy and advokist who writes and wields Ravnica's law-magic and makes a bid to free the Orzhov from the Obzedat.

entities.name: Karlov
entities.description: Teysa's deceased, domineering grandfather, a ghost of the Obzedat who forces her into obedience and revokes her title of advokist.

entities.name: Tajic
entities.description: A Boros knight who is Teysa's ally and who tunneled secretly to the Obzedat's record room; he hates ghosts.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who, as the Living Guildpact, was pressed by Teysa weeks earlier to affirm twenty minor laws.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: The dragon who tested the Living Guildpact after his victory over the guild champions in the Maze.

entities.name: Grugg brothers
entities.description: Brothers who serve Teysa and tidy her desk.

entities.name: Teysa's uncle
entities.description: A more recent member of the Obzedat whose preserved body Teysa greets in the chamber; he told her the bodies were burnt.

entities.name: Obzedat
entities.description: The ghostly ruling council of the Orzhov guild, made up of dead patriarchs and matriarchs, who dominate Teysa.

entities.name: Orzhov Syndicate
entities.description: The church-guild of Ravnica ruled by the Obzedat, holding its members in debt.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: The soldier guild of Ravnica, to which Tajic belongs.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: The law-keeping guild of Ravnica whose senate alone can remove an advokist's title.

entities.name: Guildpact
entities.description: The magical law that binds Ravnica's guilds, now embodied in a living body; what the Guildpact speaks is law.

entities.name: The Maze
entities.description: The contest in which guild champions competed and lost, after which the Guildpact took a body.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city-plane governed by ten guilds and law-magic.

entities.name: Orzhova
entities.description: The church-city of the Orzhov, with a basilica and a Boros outpost prison.

entities.name: Obzedat chamber
entities.description: A jewel-lined chamber beneath Orzhova holding the preserved bodies of the Obzedat, where the Guildpact's law does not apply.

entities.name: The Official Accord and Guidance of the Guilds of Ravnica
entities.description: The law book Teysa wrote before the Maze.

entities.name: Thrull
entities.description: A servant creature of the Orzhov that Karlov summons to take Tajic to the dungeon.

events.summary: Teysa returns from another day of being yelled at by the Orzhov Ghost Council and reads her old mail by the fire.
events.quote: Teysa Karlov had spent another full day being yelled at by the dead.

events.summary: Teysa recalls weeks earlier badgering the Living Guildpact into affirming twenty minor laws until he threw her out.
events.quote: After asking him to confirm no less than twenty minor laws and legal requirements

events.summary: Teysa resolves to use a loophole created by the Guildpact's new body to challenge the Obzedat's monopoly.
events.quote: She could manipulate this technicality to challenge the monopoly of the Obzedat.

events.summary: Her ghostly grandfather Karlov appears and lectures her to think of her blood, and she is forced to kiss his ring.
events.quote: subserviently kissed the outline of the Councilman's gossamer ring.

events.summary: Karlov offers her a coin, and Teysa uses it to buy a knife.
events.quote: Teysa used that coin to buy a knife.

events.summary: Disguised and shackled, Teysa is led by Tajic through Orzhova to a Boros outpost prison.
events.quote: There was a Boros outpost prison near the edge of the main church building.

events.summary: In a basement cell Tajic reveals the secret tunnel he carved to the Obzedat's record room, and Teysa explains her law-magic plan.
events.quote: All I need to do is directly reference a law affirmed by him and it must be made manifest.

events.summary: Teysa recites guild law to open a hidden wall with a warrant and to expose a web of security threads in the records library.
events.quote: Small threads appeared in the air, reflecting a web of silvery shimmers in the light of the torch.

events.summary: Teysa uses her blood and an article of the Orzhovniha to open the gem-encrusted door of the Obzedat's sanctum.
events.quote: The blood was quickly absorbed as a lock deep within the structure released.

events.summary: They find the preserved, mummified bodies of the Obzedat on thrones, and Teysa greets her uncle's body.
Teysa pulls up a jeweled chest of records and finds an old Orzhov logbook that Tajic judges to be proof of financial corruption.
events.quote: My gut says this is probably the proof you're looking for.

events.summary: Teysa invokes the law of exposure, but the logbook becomes immovable and Tajic cannot lift it.
events.quote: No matter how hard he tried, he could not pick it up.

events.summary: Teysa discovers the Guildpact's law can be broken in the chamber when Tajic easily takes her knife.
events.quote: The law can be broken in this room,

events.summary: Karlov reveals himself and summons the Obzedat, who rise from the floor.
events.quote: Tajic yelled with surprise as dozens of ghosts swiftly rose from beneath the floor.

events.summary: Karlov has a thrull take Tajic to the Obzedat dungeon.
events.quote: Summon a thrull to escort the Boros to our dungeon,

events.summary: The Obzedat revoke Teysa's title of advokist and forbid her the practice of law.
events.quote: By order of the Obzedat, your title of advokist is hereby revoked .

events.summary: Karlov tells her to come to the tower to discuss her remaining title as Grand Envoy and leaves.
Alone, Teysa realizes the title of Grand Envoy was only a way to keep her in debt, takes Tajic's sword as a cane and walks toward the stairs.
events.quote: The title of Grand Envoy was never a gift. It was a way to keep her bound.

relations.quote: The fat, opulent folds of her deceased grandfather, Karlov, ghosted through the closed window of her study.

relations.note: Tajic helps Teysa and she hopes for a guild alliance.
relations.quote: She needed her friend Tajic for the purpose of sneaking her in

relations.note: Tajic is a knight of the Boros.
relations.quote: nodded at the knight of the Boros.

relations.note: Teysa is Grand Envoy of the Orzhov.
relations.quote: She, Teysa Karlov of the Orzhov Guild, was in debt.

relations.note: Teysa is bound to obey the Obzedat and kiss Karlov's ring.
relations.quote: You owe us your unquestioning service.

relations.note: Karlov is a Councilman among the Obzedat ghosts.
relations.quote: The Grand Envoy of the Orzhov seeks to upend the council.

relations.note: Teysa seeks to challenge and escape the Obzedat.
relations.quote: She could manipulate this technicality to challenge the monopoly of the Obzedat.

relations.target: The Official Accord and Guidance of the Guilds of Ravnica
relations.quote: She had written The Official Accord and Guidance of the Guilds of Ravnica long before the Maze.
